name: LiveCare, Inc.
summary: LiveCare, Inc. is committed to tackling the pervasive diabetic epidemic and other chronic illnesses by blending cutting-edge technological advancements with a personalized, human-centric approach. Specializing in real-time health data analysis, support services, and patient monitoring, the company primarily delivers targeted solutions to individuals afflicted with Type II diabetes. This firm was established in 2018 and operates out of its headquarters in Venice, Florida.
